visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black, short hair and a blunt fringe is centered in a medium close-up shot. She wears a grey and black textured sleeveless knit vest over a black shirt. She stands against a plain indoor beige background featuring a minimalist art poster titled 'DAVID HOCKNEY'. A large red and white UNIQLO logo is superimposed in the center. (2) The woman puts on a pair of dark-framed sunglasses with amber/yellow lenses. She adjusts them with her hands, turning her head slightly to display the frames. The lighting is bright and even, casting minimal shadows on her face. Red product labels appear in the top-left area. (3) She transitions to wearing a thin silver metallic frame with light blue/lavender lenses. She brings her fingers close to the bridge of the glasses to highlight the design. The camera remains static at eye-level throughout the process. (4) The woman puts on a thick black acetate frame with clear lenses. She maintains direct eye contact with the lens while speaking, her facial expressions animated and smiling. Additional red text overlays provide technical product codes. (5) In the final visual phase, she appears wearing all three pairs simultaneously: one on her face, one resting on her head like a headband, and the third hanging from her vest's neck. A price overlay appears at the bottom center.

[Subtitle]: 它的這個形狀切的. (6) [Subtitle]: 有一點點特別. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個鏡片就是. (8) [Subtitle]: 我很喜歡的那種. (9) [Subtitle]: 俗稱渣男墨鏡. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後第二副呢. [Slogan]: 金屬風運動太陽眼鏡 477068. (11) [Subtitle]: 是這種銀框的. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後這個顏色呢. (13) [Subtitle]: 是我過去完全沒有的. (14) [Subtitle]: 這種冷調的鏡片. (15) [Subtitle]: 重點是 它這個銀. (16) [Subtitle]: 不是那種閃到嚇死人的銀. (17) [Subtitle]: 它是這種有質感的霧銀色. (18) [Subtitle]: 再來第三副. [Slogan]: 威靈頓運動太陽眼鏡 477573. (19) [Subtitle]: 是我自己這次初想嘗試. (20) [Subtitle]: 這種很粗框的眼鏡. (21) [Subtitle]: 這副戴起來就是. (22) [Subtitle]: 跟平時的我非常不一樣. (23) [Subtitle]: 我看起來像數學很好之外呢. (24) [Subtitle]: 就是超級熱心助人. (25) [Subtitle]: 還會借同學抄抄答案. (26) [Subtitle]: 而且我覺得最誇張就是. (27) [Subtitle]: 這1 2 3副. (28) [Slogan]: 都只要590元. [Variety]: 超級可以買.
